seoTitle: Lorem Ipsum Generator for Layout Mockups
metaDescription: Generate placeholder text by words, sentences or paragraphs for a draft layout.
intro: Generate placeholder text by words, sentences or paragraphs for a draft layout.
about: Lorem ipsum gives a draft layout realistic text blocks while the final copy is being written. Use it to check spacing and wrapping on different screens.
example: Generate one paragraph, paste it into your article card, and check whether the description wraps cleanly at mobile width.

faqs.question: Can I control the length?
faqs.answer: Choose words, sentences or paragraphs, then set the amount before generating the text.
